data.change_summary: Added jam detection: monitored PE-1002 (X11) while conveyor (Y10) runs using 5.0s timer (T10). If T10 completes, it sets the jam alarm (M190), stopping the conveyor.
data.program_il:
; ST10_CONVEYOR (FX5U) - converted from FX3U project CV_ST1_V2, 2019

LDI    X13
OUT    M191             ; ST10 motor overload alarm

LD     X1
RST    M190

LD     M190
OR     M191             ; ST10 motor overload alarm
ORI    X0               ; ES-0001 E-stop chain healthy
OUT    M199

LD     X2               ; SS-0003 auto mode
ANI    M199
OUT    Y10

LD     X10
OUT    M100             ; ST10 pallet in position

LDP    X14              ; RQ-1005 release request
SET    Y11              ; XY-1004 stopper release

LD     Y11              ; XY-1004 stopper release
OUT    T11 K20

LD     T11
RST    Y11              ; XY-1004 stopper release

LD     X11              ; PE-1002 entry photo-eye
AND    Y10              ; Conveyor motor running
OUT    T10 K50          ; 5.0s jam timer

LD     T10
SET    M190             ; Set jam alarm

END
